queries.title: Movers
queries.gherkin:
Given stocks from index nifty50
When let open = latest in 1 samples of day open
* let close = latest in 1 samples of day close
* let high = latest in 1 samples of day high
* let low = latest in 1 samples of day low
Then let condition = (close - open) / open 
* list upMovers = tickers with condition > 0.01
* list downMovers = tickers with condition < 0.01
* let dayLength = high - low
* list hammer = tickers with close - low > 0.6 * dayLength and open - low > 0.6 * dayLength
* list invertedHammer = tickers with abs(high - close) > 0.6 * dayLength and abs(high - open) > 0.6 * dayLength
queries.regex:
Given ^stocks from index (\w+(?:,*\s*\w*)*)$
When ^let (\w+) = (\w+) in (\d+) samples of (\w+) (\w+)$
* ^let (\w+) = (\w+) in (\d+) samples of (\w+) (\w+)$
* ^let (\w+) = (\w+) in (\d+) samples of (\w+) (\w+)$
* ^let (\w+) = (\w+) in (\d+) samples of (\w+) (\w+)$
Then ^let (\w+) = (.+)$
* ^list (\w+) = tickers with (.+)$
* ^list (\w+) = tickers with (.+)$
* ^let (\w+) = (.+)$
* ^list (\w+) = tickers with (.+)$
* ^list (\w+) = tickers with (.+)$

When let ema10Min = minimum in 10 samples of day close ema 10
* let ema20Min = minimum in 10 samples of day close ema 20
* let ema10Max = maximum in 10 samples of day close ema 10
* let ema20Max = maximum in 10 samples of day close ema 20
* let ema10Change = change in 10 samples of day close ema 10
* let ema20Change = change in 10 samples of day close ema 20
Then let hasCross = ema10Min < ema20Min and ema10Max > ema20Max
* let isUp = ema10Change > 0 and ema20Change > 0

* list downCross = tickers with hasCross and isDown
